Distinguish this higher-level autonomous experimentation/data-acquisition API from the separately versioned fvGP Gaussian-process engine reviewed in the adjacent lead.

decision_reason: The DOE Bitbucket repository explicitly states it is archived/read-only and that new development occurs at github.com/marcpaterno/cubacpp. I inspected the current public C++ source and actual license: the LICENSE grants GPL-3.0-or-later plus Fermilab/U.S. Government rights; the README MIT badge is inconsistent with this controlling license text. The 2023 Fermilab cosmology report uses cubacpp3 for multidimensional integrals in code/tests and links the DOE Bitbucket source, while Fermilab's code-report list includes a cubacpp release. The current source includes CMake build/test instructions and substantive code activity in January 2026.
